exposure: Low-dose misoprostol with concurrent cervical Foley
outcome: Time from first misoprostol dose to delivery
cohort: Nulliparous women who delivered nonanomalous, term, singleton pregnancies at the University of California San Francisco (UCSF).
finding: The implementation of an evidence-based cervical ripening protocol using low-dose misoprostol with concurrent cervical Foley did not significantly change time to delivery, rate of cesarean delivery, or cesarean delivery for fetal indications.
